ann.t: Copy of Newspaper Publication — Please find enclosed newspaper intimation for unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026.
Press Release — Cipla Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 27, 2026, titled "Q2FY27 Financial Results".
Outcome of Board Meeting — Cipla Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
General Updates — Notice to shareholders and creditors in accordance with NCLT Order dated 18th August, 2026 regarding merger of Inzpera Healthsciences Limited with the Company.
Amalgamation/Merger — Cipla Limited has informed the Exchange about receipt of order from Hon'ble NCLT, Mumbai Bench.
Allotment of Securities — Cipla Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 7850 securities pursuant to ESOP/ESPS at its meeting held on July 31, 2026
Copy of Newspaper Publication — Cipla Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of the unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30th June, 2026.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Cipla Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended June 30, 2026.
Change in Auditors — Cipla Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Auditors of the company.
Allotment of Securities — Cipla Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 17915 securities pursuant to ESOP/ESPS on May 14, 2026
Appointment — Cipla Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Ms Joshi Apte & Associates as Cost Auditors of the company w.e.f. April 01, 2026.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Cipla Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026.
Resignation — Cipla Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of  Mr. Umang Vohra  as Managing Director & CEO of the company w.e.f. April 01, 2026.
Updates — Mr Pradeep Bhadauria, Global Chief Scientific Officer has resigned to pursue interests outside Cipla and his last working day will be 31st March, 2026.
Allotment of Securities — Cipla Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 1954 securities pursuant to ESOP/ESPS at its meeting held on March 18, 2026
Allotment of Securities — Cipla Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 8879 securities pursuant to ESOP/ESPS at its meeting held on January 28, 2026
Outcome of Board Meeting — Cipla Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended December 31, 2025.
